title: Improve The Existing Knowledge
idea:
Improve the existing Knowledge Base repository by adding Workspace Support.

Requirements:

1. Add a Workspace model.

2. Add a Workspace management page where users can:
   - create workspace
   - rename workspace
   - delete workspace

3. Each document must belong to a workspace.

4. Add a workspace selector in the main UI.

5. Search results should only return documents from the selected workspace.

6. Display workspace statistics:
   - total documents
   - total chunks
   - total embeddings

7. Add workspace information to search results:
   - workspace name
   - document name
   - chunk metadata

8. Maintain all existing functionality.

9. Maintain backwards compatibility with existing documents.

10. Ensure the application builds and runs successfully in Docker.

11. Update frontend and backend as required.

12. Create database migration if necessary.

13. Improve the UI to make workspace switching clear and user friendly.
